# Stitch Meshing source

Authors: Kui Wu, Xifeng Gao, Zachary Ferguson, Daniele Panozzo and Cem Yuksel.

Source: https://github.com/kuiwuchn/stitchMeshing/tree/ec792353eaa45f15ec9453aad62576cca5f7b3ec

This is the SIGGRAPH 2018 Stitch Meshing implementation, distinct from the 2012 Stitch Meshes paper. The copied core constructs and edits stitch meshes. Its original LGPL notice is retained in COPYING.LESSER; COPYING supplies the accompanying GPL version 3 text, copied from the recorded generic license document source in sources.tsv.

Files are unchanged. The complete original repository is pinned under sources/external/stitch-meshing. The upstream build requires Gurobi and other libraries; no build or solver/runtime adoption occurred here. Execution and independent numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
